# Feature proposal: <title>

Status: proposed / accepted / in progress / delivered

## Outcome

Describe the concrete user action, input and result. State the smallest complete slice
being implemented and the behavior that remains out of scope.

## Acceptance cases

- Normal workflow and expected visible/saved result.
- Missing/invalid input and actionable feedback.
- Cancellation/re-entry or repeat execution where relevant.
- Compatibility with existing data and interfaces.

## Ownership and contracts

- Feature ID and owned directories:
- Shared interfaces touched, with reason:
- HTTP routes and browser entry/view paths:
- Persistent records, schema version and provenance:
- External tooling/environment requirements:

## Validation

List focused tests, integration/browser checks and any real-build or hardware evidence
needed. Distinguish required verification from optional follow-up measurements.

## Decisions and open questions

Record accepted decisions and only questions that affect the next implementation step.
Link an ADR for a material shared-architecture or persistence change.

## Delivery evidence

When completed, record implemented behavior, checks actually run and remaining limitations.
Do not mark planned work delivered because its skeleton or UI placeholder exists.
